name: save-boot-29b-battle-magic-cast
description: #253 attempt 1, H3 (Magic list index = (offset + row) x 3 + column, and a restorative cast). Boot point "lists-battle" (save-boot-29): Cloud alone (HP 200/600, MP 300/300; author-chosen), materia 53 (AP 40000) in weapon slot 0 and 49 (AP 0) in slot 1, inventory slots 0-6 = item 1 x3, item 3 x2, item 0 x5, item 0 x9 x4. A press is 4 frames, then a wait of up to 30 frames for the expected read, then 8 frames. A wait metric is frames waited, 0 on a timeout (which stops the script). Only frame counts, 1/0 and small menu values leave. First menu: Down to command row 1, Circle, wait until the widget leaves 1, 30 frames. Down: row 1 (w_plan; index 3 under H3). Mark, Circle: target selection, widget 0 (tgt_wait). 20 frames, Circle: widget 0xffff, the command is taken (cast_wait). Wait until MP leaves 300 (mp_wait), then 400 frames. Checks: MP lower and HP higher than at the mark; e0 and e3 (end values) are the spell ids at list index 0 and 3; match: a rerun.

widget.description: g_BattleMenuModalWidgetId (s16 as u16; confirmed #110 for -1, 0, 1): 1 the command menu, 0 target selection, 0xffff none. Which value a Magic or Item list reads is what #253 asks; the decomp names 7 for the Summon list (src/battle/battle3.c BattleMenuInputState7).
